notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/89ba107eae21ef939e08e2df4f79ec218833d7a1.png

We’re happy to bring you the now, free forever, version of Battalion 1944 - BATTALION: Legacy. 

This release marks the closing of a chapter and final major update for Battalion. We want to thank every single player that has enjoyed and experienced our old school, back to its roots shooter over the last few years and hope you get to share in that experience once more. 

Thank you for the memories, we'll see you in the trenches!

notes.title: BATTALION: Legacy - Free // August 16th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/b64834e39800a8534d01ed91dc575df704ca304a.png
We have formally ended our relationship with Square Enix. We want to start this exciting new chapter where we began, focusing on the players.

With this in mind, we will be releasing BATTALION: Legacy for free on Steam.

We are deeply disappointed that Battalion 1944 never made it to console and we will be refunding all console Kickstarter backers. Thank you to everyone that backed the console version and we’re sorry it has taken so long to rectify this.

We appreciate the passionate support we received from the fans of Battalion and old-school shooters. We hope you continue with us on our journey to making first person shooters that are built with the community and the players at the heart of development.

What is BATTALION: Legacy? 
BATTALION: Legacy is the revisited and final version of Battalion 1944, released for free to all on August 16th 2022. We have taken the best aspects of Battalion 1944 and honed in on these to create a fluid bug free experience, featuring a working server browser, an added faction, new weapons, classic Search & Destroy game mode with all weapons available, complete UI rework and visual overhaul. Battalion: Legacy is the culmination of work consolidated into one old school experience for all to enjoy. 


The British Are Coming
With the newest version of Battalion comes an all new faction, new weapons and new ways to play classic game modes. Take up arms with the infamous Lee Enfield and finish off opponents with the powerful Webley Revolver. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/5aea0617a773fd2ef71cb4a7263ad648c2251e1d.jpg

Over 30 Weapons
An improved arsenal of personality with weapons from 4 different factions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/ade075dbc2dad6fc892d4459398c08b42f0975ea.jpg

Updated UI
BATTALION: Legacy features a much needed visual overhaul to allow for cleaner transitions from menu to gameplay. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/8f2242e958c8a73bf07405f3e207f5b66c7b4d04.png

Private Server Hosting
World-wide server locations available for public play, with in game privately hosted servers through third party available. Rent temporary free servers or purchase permanent servers for you and your friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/9c6b5936d7d7edf9a19f20d58a0cbfd17aaac130.png


Thank you for your continued support and see you in the trenches on August 16th! 
The BULKHEAD Team

notes.title: Community Highlight 1.0 - Mittelbau by Abraxxas
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/2446201654c2d5363e92cbebb7f0cbdb3b8f3acc.png
Community - the bread and butter of any foundation set aside for great things to happen. With this in mind we want to bring some of those great things to the forefront and shine a light on roads less travelled. The Steam Workshop features fine selection of custom maps and original content for your Custom Server needs and its our duty to help find those diamonds in the rough! 
OverviewMittelbau by creator Abraxxas is the first to take centre court in our Community Highlight. Taking inspiration from other popular maps, Mittlebau houses a plethora of winding streets and scenery whilst keeping layout at the forefront in its earliest iteration. With over 500 hours in designing and testing alone, the intricate process of assessing what does and does not belong as the overall design evolves can be a tedious for many, but creator Abraxxas is still set on course to have a fully fleshed out map which transfers well to Battalion 1944's pace. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/1ee6afaecca88a484c23367656b375e7b2464dad.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/73eab4620d3c1cbe5383a925600845a9948adb56.jpg
 

About The CreatorWith a passion for PC gaming that spans no shorter than 30 years, Abraxxas has been fueled by his interest for creating innovative experiences on a multitude of scales. Fueled by the games of yesteryear with heavy involvement in both Quake and Half-Life's numerous modding iterations, Abraxxas finds himself returning after a level editing hiatus to bring an originally inspired concept to the forefront of Battalion 1944 for you all to play! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/0c28938cc2ebd9e2d9750169d778255414be7317.jpg

From The Author This is the first iteration of a new map for Batallion 1944 that is inspired by Counter Strikes de_inferno. With heavy and ongoing modifications to its layout I'm always looking for feedback on how best to take the map to the next level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/a7f3d666b198d9b7574b28a472f240a07092350d.png

With approximately 500+ hours designing and testing so far. Level design is an iterative process that often entails spending countless hours working on particular assets, only for them to later be scrapped, as the overall design evolves.

I have always been passionate about game development, and particularly level design. Quake and Half-Life modding is what initially sparked this interest, and my desire manifest ideas into reality is stronger now than ever before. Upon discovering Battalion 1944, and quickly becoming addicted -- I realized that the dev kit was available, and immediately got to work on my own design. The map de_inferno, from Counter-Strike, has long been a personal favorite, dating back to pre-1.6 days. Although it has long been one of my favorites, there have always been various flaws throughout the map that often lead to the map feeling one-sided. With this in mind, I have made various changes and adaptations throughout the layout to provide a more balanced and faster playing level. The map has evolved into an entirely new experience that should be reminiscent of old-school games, but optimized for the speed and intensity of Battalion 1944.

None of the visual detailing is finished and some assets have no been built yet. This is because I want to ensure the layout plays well before spending time creating assets that might be replaced (if the layout changes).

Please leave feedback with what you like or do not like, as it relates to the layout of the map. I am well aware that various buildings are incomplete, and some are missing textures. Thank you in advance for any feedback provided!

How To Play Playing Mittlebau has never been easier, with 2 server options in as many regions you can hop on now and put the map through its paces! Copy and paste one of the ip's below, open the console [`] and hit enter!

notes.title: Autumn Mid Season Update NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/99ea1efcc9600606736d9198765f5681cf5410ad.png
The leaves have fallen, browned by Autumn chills and shortened days, the season’s changes in full effect and that's no different for Battalion 1944.
Quelling the Infection and 50% OFF SaleOur Halloween game mode acted as the faux beginning to our MSU (Mid Season Update) as we looked to focus more on content and improving the ‘casual’ experience for new players and existing community. Since Infection’s launch last week, we have received a tremendous amount of feedback from those of you to have braved the undead plague. Over the last few days we’ve been adding new maps to keep the mode fresh moving forward (Having added Liberation, Vanguard, Coastal and today Derailed!) before its removal from our event queue tomorrow alongside the ending of our 50% OFF Halloween Sale. Many an undead scourge has met their unrelenting end that is the Baikal double barreled shotgun. Many a daring soldier has joined the tainted forces of the Infected having fallen first in combat. For those of you that missed out, do not worry. Your own personal Infection is ready to break out across the Community Server Browser as the mode will now be hostable for all those that wish to do so. With many maps still to try, we look forward to seeing how you utilise the environment to your advantage! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/d5c1dbd6ee0aabcd0cf2f8536924e63b3ebb22bc.png

New Player New UsAccessibility is key and the new player experience can be a daunting foothold to undertake for a game with a competitive nature. Due to this we’re adding new training modes to make that crossover easier for those joining us for the first time. Learning nades or smokes can be a time consuming yet rewarding experience but we can’t expect you to learn on the job. We’ve now included an easily accessible ‘Grenade Training’ mode which will grant you a full selection of maps, more nades than mouse clicks and a helpful follow function that enables you to see just how good your throwing arm is. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/7990d7470cb85df52a38e897b7470b7b34b01a80.gif

Alongside our Grenade Training is a new ‘VS Bots’ mode. Learning maps, positions, weapons and everything in between at your own pace is now a one way ticket to getting the edge on the enemy. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/05b0a699835e7c35290e491a028ff5465547634d.png

Improving Animation We’ve made changes to how the Trench Gun looks and feels making for a more natural, smoother and overall supreme animation. Sprinting now looks as it should as you grapple for control of those tight corners in close proximity combat and the new kick gives it a satisfying feel as you land that all important blow on the opposition. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/313d924da2914cad143223ee4a238bb808aae6cd.gif

Knife To Meet You: Part 1.5To bring the knife more inline with its counterparts we’ve added a crosshair, this is an important addition for those looking to line up grenades as we set in motion how we want to change the scape of melee combat based on feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/f28b021625cb4dc072e56856c26529f2e145ffe5.png 

Taking InventoryWe’ve made some changes to the inventory system and how filters work, meaning you can find and equip skins in a much more efficient manner. A small quality of life change in our ongoing changes to how we’re looking to how players interact with the UI and vice versa. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/e0a64af574ac9a92dc598f86f606615e999ca8f8.png

240 FPS CapWe’ve increased the FPS Cap from 200 to 240 to better support the ongoing advances in monitor hardware. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/93af4d9d9545e16d53cb07ce19941f49e689df88.png

Server Browser Fixes and Community MindsetWith the server browser in mind, we’ve started to address issues some of you have had whilst implementing small quality of life changes to improve your journey into a community led environment. Community plays a stand out foundation for Battalion 1944 so for us these changes are an important starting point for how we can better evolve overall. 

Our first quality of life improvement and sort after tool is the ‘Favourite’ feature. You can now click the helpful star icon next to the servers ping and these servers will continue to stay at the top of your Server Browser come rain or shine. Finding your go to servers has never been easier! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/0b5d4e13377f5dd737b9e12aa868483423afd2c3.png

Another server browser issue we’re looking to tackle is the correct ping being displayed within the browser itself. Below you can find a quick and helpful guide from our man in the cloud James Tatum as to why custom servers may show their current values and how to combat that issue if you’re a server host.
When setting up a server, the "QueryPort" in the launch command should always be the "Port" number + 3. For example, if your "Port" is set as 7777, your "QueryPort" should be 7780. If this is not the case, ping will always be shown as either 999 or 0. If this IS the case and your ping is still showing as either 999 or 0, it means that steam cannot ping your server. This is likely due to a firewall or port forwarding issue.
With a focus on the community we’ll also be looking to start an ongoing ‘Community Highlight’, we’ll be talking to those that create custom maps and the likes with ways for players to try and test them in an environment for all to enjoy. This will be starting in the near future so if you’ve got a map you’d like to show off, feel free to reach out to us on our Discord! 

Bliztkrieg Battle and LadderHosted by The Plays, the Blitzkrieg Battles will once again feature every Sunday until December 1st. Enter via their FACEIT hub for your chance to win $/€250 every week in both our North American and European regions! Also coming is their new 5v5 ladder in cooperation with Mogul.gg for more nostalgia led system that will have you competing with Battalion's best and brightest! 

https://www.faceit.com/en/organizers/6cdde2da-1cea-46c3-9957-dd337fa18686/The%20Plays

https://mogul.gg/tournaments/details/22281/5v5-battalion-1944-ladder-by-the-plays

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/f4c7e93558c64d851cfe9a7047daa2b0af84621a.png

Have a great weekend! 
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Infection! Halloween Special Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/d5c1dbd6ee0aabcd0cf2f8536924e63b3ebb22bc.png
They say “When there is no more room in hell the Dead will walk the earth” and it appears there's no room in the inn, off to the barns with you. An infection has reanimated fallen Axis soldiers in our undead game for this week's runup to Halloween with only survival at stake. War can be gruesome, but a swarm of our nightmares finest going bump in the night can be much much worse. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/db287686c508db3e847475331e88abcaae09a35b.png
Infection! Introducing Infection, Battalion 1944's new eerie, Halloween game mode set to launch this afternoon. The infected have risen, still craving the remnants of war. There is no solace to be found in the eyes of the reanimated and those strong few will have a tough time on the battlefield. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/162907fda4f0191d50a3351a8ac7d9c47fa60505.png
No trick, all treat, darkness falls upon our Manorhouse map which has been reimagined for those brave enough to go toe to toe with the Infected. Featuring a number of aesthetically haunting changes you and your squad must act fast to hold off the unrelenting swarm being careful not to fall victim to your pursuers. If you’re unfortunate enough to join the undead horde then don’t worry, increased speed awaits you in the ‘not so’ afterlife making for a fun, frantic and frightful game mode! Though the event runs in its own queue till October 31st, our Infection game mode will still be accessible via the community server browser for all those that choose to host their own frightful servers with access to ALL maps! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/3b8c55412809f506c54cf47ddd85f7f4f2807937.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/c6bc6bede87f24dc54d5ff49eddd5a449853d5e6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/c6cddb583bebc4797ff58fa388ded526472d0fc9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/993c22e2cc204f221a40efe61e0976b242c49473.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/f2a09a8ddbed6774116d09ea08b00bc72a3178f5.png

XP ChangesAs we look to constantly address and revitalise how XP is distributed in Battalion 1944, we have made some small changes to better accommodate our Arcade audience. More often than not players will be rewarded for how good they are rather than the time they invest which can force a divide that we wouldn’t like to support. Time not ability will be rewarded as we look to move away from the often hard felt grind of players with only limited play time. In spite of this, we have increased all Arcade win and loss by 500% and 400% respectively. This change will make for better pacing of our 2 month seasons without overly punishing those for missing out. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/18c12056ad655fb6111d0fd3298d43cb7827ff5c.png

Trick or Treat Warchest!Halloween wouldn't be the same without a few spooky cosmetics to see you through. For the entirety of our special event, Level Ups will now drop 'Trick or Treat' Warchests featuring up to 9 themed skins, including a new slasher themed knife! 

Looking Towards Mid SeasonWith our Autumn MSU on the horizon we're still working towards our goal of improving the overall feel and quality of Battalion 1944. We're still on track to make changes at the end of October and on wards as we continue to support Battalion for our wonderful community.

We hope you guys have a fang-tastic weekend! 
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: FREE WEEKEND AND NEW PLAYER GUIDE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/98ffbf76708a382611e045accc9d92ced391d370.png
Battalion 1944 is happy to welcome all new players joining us this weekend from October 3rd right the way through till October 7th! We can’t wait to have you try our game for the first time and enjoy the classic FPS experience that has moulded many a generation. If you enjoy it, don’t forget you can grab the game right now for 50% Off from our Steam Store! 

What is Battalion 1944? Battalion 1944 is an ode to classic FPS titles of yesteryear, a true test of skill, teamwork and impactful plays in a World War 2 setting. During Battalion’s time in early access we developed features, functionality and plenty of content updates in collaboration with our community. As a result, Battalion taken on its own identity with its own classic competitive edge. Front and center we have Wartide - a highly competitive, single-life, round-based mode that requires just as much tactical and strategic  knowhow as it does skill. After that we have fan favouirtes such as Rifles Only, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Headquarters and more -Players can expect to have their reflexes and ability tested to their full potential as they work their way through Season 6 of our BattleRank system where they can accumulate FREE War Chests and skins for all their aesthetic needs!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/34fe7f873ab20593f4961658cd3d936e68afd8f9.png

Wartide! Once you’re done running, gunning and fighting your way up the scoreboard, how about turning up the heat? Battalion 1944 features its very own competitive game mode called Wartide! In Wartide, 2 teams of 5 will face off against each other in a grueling 24 round showdown of attack and defence. As the attacking team tries to plant the bomb, destroying 1 of 2 enemy objectives, the defending side will use communication, aim and impactful plays to stop the opposing side. 

Wartide also plays home to its own economy system, as teams dispatch their foes, win rounds and complete the objective, they’ll earn tokens to spend on an array of weaponry to aid them in combat to take home the victory. Though be mindful to not overspend, as a poor economy can mean the difference between triumph and being punished. Those of you that do suffer a loss of tokens, fear not! A helpful ‘Donate Token’ option can be found on the Buy Menu (B) meaning teammates can lift each other out of perils grasp! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/ef49663be94c4cb2e12c682781141b196406f776.png

With Competitive Wartide comes a full ELO led environment with FACEIT integration for you to climb ladders and earn prizes in your journey to the top of your chosen region. For those of you looking to play our competitive mode without the pressure it can sometimes bring, Unranked Wartide is but a few clicks away for you to learn weapons, maps, nades and strats. Play at your own pace, solo or with friends, the choice is yours! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/35f0b23f433146f60502c5608bdbf8cca0bc1ee0.png

Special Event: Free For All Rifles OnlyRifles Only has played a big part in Battalion’s journey thus far. A perfect way to warmup and improve your aim, this fast paced arena will have you well on your way to becoming Battalion 1944’s number one sharpshooter. Now on its own queue for instant access! 

Where to Begin? Every experienced, new, and returning FPS gamer has a preference when it comes to their ingame settings. We here at Bulkhead Interactive understand the joy in fine tuning our in game environment to cater both to our aesthetic and technical needs. Via the Settings you can change a multitude of options to have your game better represent the player you are. Whether you’re looking you’re keen on atmospherics or a minimalistic competitive gamer, Battalion’s ingame Tune has you covered for the first few steps with our Beauty and Performance options. Below you will be granted the versatility to create a game with a look and feel you adore. Stuck for frames? Try enabling Forward Renderer and kick your game into gear for those on the lower side of the performance spectrum. Not a fan of the lense flare or head bob? Turn it off! Your game, your rules. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/570200bc96ff01f5157e99265d808f4b6d015cc1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/6793e4a25dc9d17c4b96b4868eba13a5b9b4ca2e.png

On top of this we also include the appropriate options for you to bind your weapons how you like, guns and player model position can be changed as you see fit as well as having recently added the game’s melee option as its very own entity, meaning you can now delegate between the 3 weapon slots in any manner you like. Play around with it and see what fits you best! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/f98fb5395a2d25f2ff793f59c84e09f8f7e39ef4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/12da89b9cc53e2e573d64dca801a2519c6fd10ed.png

We suggest doing all of the above and getting a real feel for your new weaponry on our training map Upottery! You’ll find a selection of every weapon featured in the game, alongside targets to fire at to get a feel for recoil and a helpful obstacle course to improve your movement. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/67acefe9da825fcde59cc147b0eb00c88066ebad.png

Making FriendsBattalion 1944 is home to a kind and helpful community found on the games Official Discord. Our server acts as a one stop shop for all your Battalion needs, whether that be tech or FACEIT support, interactable live development streams, a place to find like minded gamers and much much more! We can’t wait to have you join us and hope you stick around for a while. 

https://discord.gg/kWKXrGw

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/21442a067741bea682fcaea2d23d97d65926aac0.png

We here at Bulkhead Interactive are extremely grateful to all those that join us on our journey this weekend. Battalion 1944 is an ongoing, ever evolving experience that has its community at its heart. With a lot more to look forward to in the future we really do hope you enjoy your time with us and the game we’ve created that will only get better! 

Have a great weekend and see you online
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Autumn Season Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/29e3517769e5d540ea84d7f0c00298a0f8270528.png
With the Free Weekend announcement well under way, what better time for our Autumn Season Update to hit the ground running! 

The Autumn Season Update is the second seasonal update in Battalion 1944's road map since release as part of our ongoing support to improve the games, and our players overall experience. This month is no different as we look to change the dynamic of the playing field whilst maintaining the competitive integrity of the game! How do we do this you ask, well lets get into it.

Knife To Meet You!Knives in Battalion 1944 can now be fully equipped. Using a third weapon slot, taking the law into your own hands has never been easier. Pre-match knife rounds feel more rounded, movement is aesthetically improved and using Mouse 2 will silently walk you out of any sticky situation much like the pistol. We felt with the inclusion of new knife skins in our Summer Update, it was only fair for players to inspect their new armaments in the same fashion as their counterparts - but why stop at an inspect? Each knife has its own equip animation giving what we feel is a more pleasing to the eye experience. Knives currently play a primarily cosmetic role but this doesn't mean we won't be monitoring feedback moving forward!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/86ff62a57e9c230df2872f9236e2467a303dda0f.gif
For those of you with configs set in stone, we suggest rebinding the following to pave the way for your new weapon. 
 Primary Quick Switch 1
 Secondary Quick Switch 2
 Melee Quick Switch 3
 Next Weapon Mouse Wheel Down
 Previous Weapon Mouse Wheel Up

Invasion Persuasion
After Invasion's week long testing during our Special Event stage we are pleased to announce that the map will be making a full time return to our Arcade and Competitive game modes! Invasion has come a long way and now we get to see how our community really put it through its paces in the competitive environment. A lot of positions that were utilised during previous stages have been fixed to keep the balance of play but we recognise the importance and celebration of team creativity so are interested to see what you guys find next! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/fd28086495a6943a97d15e1f6e6d71c930e6b613.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/dfe7c81e873e2bd1f18aeb9b994abd951eb420cf.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/ecfd61ce09fbaa6227efdb0449279531e0f7bf27.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/2099435ac03e8e5e04d999a41340d72d1268d3ea.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/a22a04002cb17ebb2e6abf8caecfc81e295c6948.jpg

The next map to receive the rework treatment will be Savoia which will be entering the fray during Autumn's Mid Season Update in our attempt to flesh out a well received pool of maps the community can be proud of. For those of you that want to get involved with future development then look no further than our discord and social channels for Live Stream announcements with Brammer! 

Map Call Outs AddedCommunication is key in the line of duty, a foot put wrong in the line of fire means comms can hit a breaking point. One way we've set out to help new players are map call outs found underneath the Minimap. If you've ever been unsure of where you're at, worry no longer. 

The Red Sun UpgradeSupport Battalion's ongoing development this month as we take inspiration from the Pacific Theatre of War. The Red Sun Upgrade Pack is a limited time release which will be in stores until Monday 7th October. 

Every purchase contributes directly to Battalion’s ongoing development. The Red Sun Upgrade contains x10 Red Sun Warchest and the NEW M1 Garand | Wrapped! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/588ba63a38490603ea64faed41881e283c3265ed.gif

These Seasonal Upgrades pave a way for us to aim higher. Starting on October 3rd at 6pm BST in collaboration with our Free Weekend, you can grab this upgrade with a 33% discount as well as the 50% discount for our full game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/1eb5eab8bae7bf49f41be7b4770a5adf3a2ac342.png 
The Red Sun Warchest The Red Sun Warchest takes inspiration from the far East providing a multitude of new skins for an array of weapons within Battalion 1944. Tucked away deep inside is another new knife for you to flip, shank and shake around in the trenches. Why float like a butterfly when you could sting like one? Introducing, the Butterfly Knife. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/cecb31efa1b555844f1c03258ff2d1b1412fd1a4.png

There are three ways to get these skins: 

[olist]
 You can purchase them in-game by clicking 'Buy War Chests' 
 Buy 'The Red Sun DLC' on Steam and you'll receive 10 Red Sun Chests AND the Wrapped M1 Garand.
 By hitting rank 100 in Season 6 of BattleRank, every rank after 100 will drop 1 Red Sun Warchest!
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/ce359a69433f691eef5b7b565b4d95bb99205af7.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/2a93ce67eb45675e12b103c172ec062733a6d333.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/d5b4d50a147a71fbb441810a1755cec6b0d122c2.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/bf5cca69b630bb652812b57cf1c1eede213a640b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/83b72d7cf2e6085afbda71682c35955ecb4854db.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/cc032e6c08d105079fc1dd1e40f2906b724689a2.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/a850060763a2612467dfa724ec16505009dcd916.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/1357d3b489a71816706bc4e2046859c9613e3404.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/6386ed36f7155b45615e8b0200d36510408ccc82.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/5667c4bf90adee1c1d7c67cd9e4670e4ca56630d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/1d449172791539839aadcbf83381550d739357a1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/9c4ad30ea89d331a89c1f20c409a836a0deaf145.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/ec570ea2ad422edfe67a381556b3702d6082f265.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/98018ac5f556664cd57e54d027f9d466c22f2733.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/3d772dda01c7f149e6fdee3e2f557f0dcf861ddf.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/bafbaaea7a874169d83134d163db724f256d824a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/593a74d6141b90916bd1c8e580af03280c25b50c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/b599817677c48bbfdec27e1b4c30e3dd62b14d9e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/cefc765515fb09bab4873254e44e76029462d2c9.png

With that comes the Mid Season Update expected in approximately one month (or sooner) to tie in a whole new trick of changes and treat of festivities. Take a look at the skins we've got lined up!

notes.title: Double XP Weekend & What's To Come
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/91af240448fdfd5c7082955d225b909cf29f6fd5.pngWith another season comes another update, Autumn (or Fall for those of you across the pond) brings a new batch of ideas, gameplay changes and map design. But first let's talk about the now. 
Wrapping up Season 5 - Double XP Season 5 played home to one of our biggest seasons to date. With weapon balances, map reworks, Arcade and UI improvements, our Gladiator DLC, the list goes on. None of which would have been possible without our ever supportive community. For that, we thank you. We thank you for sticking with us every step of the way and understand the qualms or frustrations some of you may have. As the saying goes, actions often speak louder than words and because of this we’ll be rolling out a Double XP weekend for all those that want to grind out the final steps in their Season 5 collection.

The Broader ScopeBattalion 1944 has undeniably come a long way since Early Access and things will only get better, one of the ways we go about this has been live development. One on one community outreach straight from our screen to yours. The next map to receive the loving embrace of our live streams will be Savoia! Ideas have already been rolling in from all regions and we can't wait to see how your decisions impact how we and future players traverse the environment. If you ever wonder how to get involved, look no further than our Discord or Twitter channels where we'll continue to announce the hows and whens of future streams. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/cc09664838a995ed4b7e45c541265a9d5ba08961.png

What We Do in the Shadows?Behind closed doors cogs turn and pieces fall into place as is the way with development. Often we want to shout from the rooftops, howling at the moon on a dark night about what we're working on and when its coming to fruition. We want that just as much as our community and though sometimes this can't be the case we can give you a taste of the long term. Our team work scrupulously to create content for our upcoming British invasion, fun in game events and offline celebrations for those of a competitive nature and we can't wait to hear you opinions. No matter how 'ghoulish' they might be! 
 
Autumn Season UpdateWe know you guys love to be kept in the know and often things can seem quiet, but don't worry as we're always working hard to cultivate Battalion and grow on the foundations we have sewn. Our mission shall remain the same. Improve, improve, improve. 

As the sun rises on Season 6, set to launch next week, we look to shape the game in a new way implementing an often requested feature, reintroduce a certain map to the competitive pool and push on with some previous plans to improve the games overall quality of life. On top of this we'll be coming in strong with a new collection of skins for you sink your teeth into as well as improving the ways in which you earn them. Overall we think we're in for a good time moving forward to Christmas and we hope you stick around to see our plans become a reality.

Now go forth and reap the benefits of Double XP! 

Have a great weekend
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Unranked Wartide & Double XP Weekend - Hotfix 23896
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26062409/bab53f4bb4bc78adebd8ea75f8eadff916ccaffd.png
Over the last five days since the release of the Mid Season Update we've been working hard to fix any and all small issues we've encountered on the way. Whilst doing so our community have been testing Invasion in our Special Event and the response has been fantastic. Using your critical feedback we can take finalise changes to Invasion making it a map we'll no doubt see in the competitive and casual map pools sooner, rather than later! For all those that have played we would just like to say thank you. But that's not all...

Unranked Wartide 
Making its return to the Battalion 1944 forefront comes Unranked Wartide. For those not in the know, Wartide is Battalion 1944's 5v5 competitive game mode - two teams face off in a 24 round showdown of attack and defence. Destroy the Axis objectives as the Allied team, whilst both factions try to outwit and outmanoeuvre each other in a game of skill and momentum. 13 rounds will take the map, baring in mind that with every round comes one life, one chance to make that game saving play, one opportunity that could make or break your teams progress.

Unranked Wartide will act as the bridging gap between our casual and competitive experience for those looking to try their hand at something different without the pressure of an ELO driven environment. Integrating this is an important choice for us and now we've various quality of life issues addressed we're glad to bring it into its own playlist! 

Maps Featured

 Liberations
 Manorhouse v2
 Coastal
 Derailed
 Vanguard

Double XP Weekend
With the addition of Unranked Wartide and in line with our recent changes to how XP works, we thought "what better time to give our wonderful community a Double XP weekend" - The time is now! Over the coming weekend and with the start of FACEIT's new season having recently begun, all XP across all of our game modes is now doubled for your Battlerank grind! 

Other Patch Notes 
 Changes to smoke to fix post processing volume issues being offset from smoke effect


We're making an ever lasting effort to support the Battalion 1944 community by addressing many issues big and small, keep an eye out for future updates and keep your fantastic feedback coming in! 

Have a great weekend

notes.title: Mid Season Update LIVE! - Casual, Invasion and Smoke Reworks
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/d037e2e316f3f979212b59d66049928264db109a.png

Four weeks have passed since the release of our first Seasonal patch in our concentrated effort to supporting Battalion 1944 long term. Mid Season has arrived, and we’re excited to show you what we have instore! Let's get started.  

The Bulk(head) Of It - The Casual Experience Over the last few weeks we’ve been keeping you guys informed with previews and developer streams as a way to better gauge what our players want most. We recognise the value in our player’s ongoing commitment which help us maintain and mould Battalion 1944 across the board. With an increased attentiveness to casual gameplay we’re really able to hone in on what make our mechanics fun to utilise in said environment as we move forward.

We’ve improved the experience ten fold by revisiting the way our players interact with game modes and each other. In previous versions of Battalion 1944 and for many of our casual community, ‘Arcade’ felt somewhat lacklustre, something we have never disagreed with, a spare part in a much bigger machine but one we intend on re-inventing as we proceed. By re-adding modes that you loved from day one to those requested across multiple avenues you can be sure we have something for you in Battalion 1944. 

Free For AllOne hotly requested game mode has been Free For All, the ultimate be your own hero shoot em up experience. Think you’re capable of doing all the heavy lifting? Now it's time to put it to the test. Up to 12 players face off in the ultimate rumble, selecting their choice of weaponry as you fight to the top of the scoreboard. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/116626e3bd9b60f2166efaa862be900034e5db79.jpg

Rifles OnlyYou read that right, with free for all comes the ever loved 1 pop till you drop fanfare. A slew of wiggles and weaves as you land the perfect shot or keep up the momentum as you make your way through the server decimating everything in your path. A classic game mode we’re excited to include in our Arcade rotation full time. As we'll be including it in the main arcade queue this means we’ll see the inclusion of the M1 Garand. We understand how this may frustrate the rifles only purists amongst us, but it's important to give players the ability to learn how to counter the bolt-action rifles with the Garand as well as allowing some players who are now voted into a rifles only game to have an alternate option with a gun that is ultimately- still a rifle.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/b120f397909ab5114432ad356a39c1930a331bcb.jpg

Arcade Map and Mode VotingWith the inclusion of the aforementioned game modes and full time positioning of HQ we have introduced map and game mode voting as a mainstay for the Arcade queue. We firmly believe that our community should get to decide how they experience the game in a casual environment and we’re now glad to give you the option. Whether it be Free for All Rifles Only on Manorhouse or Domination on Liberation. The choice is now yours. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1311491e8a8acb3b7a9b00f38717518a69eedf0f.jpg
A selection of 6 mix and match of maps and modes awaits you on the vote screen.

Test The New Invasion!Map reworks are a common trend and balance is no laughing matter. notes.title: Mid Season Preview_v2
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/e00a7bf940522e1011153c938bd5c8db21f7f336.jpg

Hello troops! Here’s a quick breakdown of what we’re bringing to the frontlines this week. 

2 More More Maps! We’re at it again, the ever expanding HQ experience sees us finally fighting on all fronts as this week we add  Derailed and Battery. Crashed planes, trains and automobiles await you in this weeks update. We've nearly come full circle with some interesting features to best assess your casual needs! 

Mid Season Patch - Preview_V2Last week we gave you a little sniff of what's to come for September’s Mid Season Patch and this week is no different. For those of you not in the know, the MSP, as we like to call it, involves a number of fixes, changes, and quality of life solutions. It’s our way of really getting to grips with what our players would like to see without disrupting the flow of progression or jumping the gun too soon. 

Quality of life you say? Quality of life is the standard of health, comfort, and happiness experienced by an individual or group. The Battalion community is our group and these small intricacies and additions are our way of implementing features you’ve asked for. One example of this would be call outs and map locations under the radar - a small change can make a world of difference for communication, whether a veteran or stepping into the server for the first time, these are exactly the kind of quality of life changes we’ll be looking to make a more permanent fixture. 

Fog of WarSmoke grenades play a huge part in Battalion’s break away defence and first line of attack. They provide the foundation for key, round winning moments, or block crucial information to prevent an opponent's advances. 

Over the last year we’ve constantly been working towards balancing and creating a formidable smoke. A smoke that does exactly what it says on the tin, and dare I say, we think we’re pretty close. We’ve improved the smoke so that players will no longer be able to turn the edge of the smoke client side using their mouse as a way to gain an advantage. You can see the difference below! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/a289f5f1ab15808b59ef581e0a61a14bedc293ae.jpg
Current smoke


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/cd008c68890eed9d17f69abce9180736ae7ce818.jpg
MSP Smoke

The greatest teams and tacticians know exactly how, when, and where to deploy smokes but often you never see the why. Why do smokes act and behave the way they do? Whats the difference between a server and client side smoke and why do we lean one way more than the other. Luckily for all those interested, we have one of Bulkhead’s brightest on standby to talk you through the process, Mr.James Tatum. 



Smoke grenades are currently a combination of server and client sided. In order to explain how smokes work, we're going to have to cover some base terms first. Stay with me, and by the end of this you'll understand why we use the combination we do, and why smokes will never be fully server sided.

First up, seeds and pseudo-random number generators. You may have heard that random numbers generated by any form of computer are not truly random. This is true. In any computational environment, we use a seed and an algorithm to generate pseudo-random numbers, which appear to be random enough for most things to get away with. We start with a value, which we call the seed. Let’s say 42. This value is chucked into a mathematical equation and a new value is spat out, let’s say 98. The 42 that was originally used is then modified by a constant (maybe just incrementing by 1) and when the algorithm is ran again on this new number a different value is given, 56. As long as the seed is the same each time you run the algorithm, you will always get the same values out of the random generator in the same order. For this reason, most random generators use the ticks of a system or something equally unique as a seed.

Next we need to talk about particle effects. Particle effects use emitters, which spawn sprites. There can be hundreds or thousands of sprites generated by an emitter, and then we can have multiple emitters in each effect. Each sprite can have some transparency on it, and once the sprites are layering over one another we end up with a cool effect, and the emitters themselves spawn the sprites based on a seed. This is where the pseudo-randomness comes in. Particle effects can be expensive to run, which is why it’s important to keep a close eye on performance when doing anything with particle effects.

Okay, so you understand how “random” works in a computational environment, and you now know the basics of how a particle effect works. Let’s get into what Battalion 1944 does.

When you throw a smoke grenade, the arc and position of the grenade is actually calculated on the server and then networked to the clients. This way, a smoke or explosive grenade can never land somewhere different for different clients. The position where the smoke lands causes the particle effect to be spawned on all clients, but not on the server. This means all clients have the same smoke in the same position, but we don’t have the insane performance cost of networking the smoke from the server to client. 

Let’s talk about that performance cost. In order to network a particle effect, you’d have to take each of the generated particles (sprites) on the server and send it’s position to each client. When we consider there can be thousands of particles in a single effect, we might be sending thousands of positions each frame to each client. For 10 players in a server, and at 60fps, for just 1000 particles, that would be 600,000 pieces of positional data sent in a second. We could definitely optimise that down, (and we’d actually need to, because that would block the net driver and disconnect everyone) but you can see how out of control the performance of networked particle effects can get.

The next thing to consider is the seed. If this was different on each client, it would cause the smoke to look different. For this reason, we keep it the same on all clients, at all times. Every time you throw a smoke, it will look the same every time because the seed value is the same.

So that’s how smokes work in Battalion 1944. The position is sent from the server, so it’s the same. The seed is always the same, because it’s a constant value fixed inside the smoke asset itself. The smoke always looks the same, because both the position and the seed are the same for all clients. There would be no benefit to networking the smoke particle effect from the server, but there would be a significant performance cost, and with the nature of Battalion 1944 being a competitive fps, we are always trying to get the best performance and competitive fairness out of everything we do. 

Hope that explains everything. If you have any questions, feel free to fire them to @Baker

Boost HotfixWe're always astounded by what our community can do with the game. Recently we came across some boosts that gave players that utilised it an unfair advantage on Liberation, this has been addressed in the latest hotfix and would like to thank those of you on Reddit that help us combat these issues. Keep up the great work!

Fragadelphia Summer Wartide 2019 Last weekend saw some of the top North American teams and a small European contingent fight it out in the aptly nicknamed "City of Brotherly Love", Philadelphia. The weekend was a spectacle of tight games and competitive spirit. As the story usually goes, only one could come out on top, this time around being that of Sedated Gaming. A marvellous performance in the final coming from the lower bracket playoffs saw them take home the victory and we'd like to take this time to formally congratulate them! Also a massive thank you to Steve of Fragadelphia and every volunteer member of staff at the event that weekend. We can't wait to see you compete again soon! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/b44e4719e4855f2de9d0c7c6a60d2f190c04d1c8.jpg

For all those that missed the action on the weekend, don't worry, you can catch up HERE!

Have a fantastic weekend!

notes.title: XP Boost and Mid Season Preview!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/6037a4c3c5115880d96cdeca72e919687525d30d.jpg

Hello troops! Here’s a quick breakdown of what we’re bringing to the frontlines this week. 

2 More Maps!
Last week saw the inclusion of both Goldrush and Vanguard into our Headquarters game mode. This week is no different as we look to expand, offering up 2 more maps into the fray! Savoia and Manorhouse v2 are the maps in question taking HQ to the sunny streets of Italy and the muddy French suburbs. By now we’re sure you’re familiar with the hassle and holding dynamics of HQ and don’t doubt you’ll enjoy it a little closer to home. 

Wartide XP Boost
Wartide plays an important part in Battalion 1944’s infrastructure, and more importantly we recognise the time you invest. Games often vary in length and we understand the levels of concentration required to play at your best. To reward this, and in light of our recent change to a Level 100 cap. We have significantly increased the XP gain from each match, win or lose! The new XP model for Wartide is now 4 times higher than it was originally, making it easier for those of you who invest the time to grind out for the skins you love. 


 Wartide win (500xp) now worth 2000xp
 Wartide loss (350xp) now worth 1750xp


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/772c6c4b72e384526fbc4d3b7a0ea865de657adf.gif

Casual XP Boost
For those of you of a more casual nature we’re giving you a helping hand as well by making small changes to the the XP gained from Challenges to alleviate any leveling woes. Remember, we’ll always be looking to evaluate XP gains across the board from our communities helpful feedback. Here’s how Challenges now stack up. 


 Daily Challenges (250xp) will now reward 500xp
 Quick Fire Challenges (150xp) will now reward 250xp



A Hardline Approach
Often player experiences vary, and here at Bulkhead we’re all for people playing the way they want as long as it doesn’t ruin the experience for those around them. In light of this we will be taking a hardline approach for those that exploit our game modes and XP models in other regions specifically to farm bots and create an unfair and often toxic gaming environment. This often results in an unenjoyable experience for many and with the adequate proof provided to us (video, screenshot or otherwise on a case by case scenario) we will be proactively banning players temporarily to combat any issues that arise. In future, and namely our Mid Season Patch, we will be making changes to completely disincentive and discourage those that abuse the systems in place with added positive reinforcement for playing objectives.

Mid Season Patch - Preview 
Yes, we’ve been reading, watching and certainly discussing. The Mid Season Patch is looking to benefit everyone across the board with quality of life features making your daily Battalion sessions a more enjoyable experience. Coming early September you can expect to see small improvements to our in game Buy Menu amongst others, these will feature: 


 See who’s talking whilst the Buy Menu is open
 Request Donation button
 Wartide Buy Menu history

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/ef49663be94c4cb2e12c682781141b196406f776.png

The Mid Season Patch holds a number of changes we can't wait for you to see, try, and test. Remember, this is just a small sneak peak of what we have in store to whet your appetites and give you a taste of what's to come. 

We’re constantly looking to improve the game as we move forward with our exciting roadmap for Battalion 1944. Which incase you missed it can be found at the link below! 

https://steamcommunity.com/games/489940/announcements/detail/2709396928711893740

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1d6402df67ca8bdd9452bb8fcc7b4102af7239f0.png

Stepping Up The Competition
This week saw the beginning of the our Blitzkrieg Premier and Open leagues in collaboration with @ThePlaysgg - Be sure to stay tuned in during the coming weeks and follow the narrative as we look to build upon Battalion 1944's competitive roots!

Be sure to also check out @fragadelphia this coming weekend where up to 16 of NA's best and brightest will be fighting it out on LAN!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/2e1bc1f459de5f3eff423203284f1d6938beee10.png


We wish all those attending the best of luck and the rest of you a great weekend! 
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: New Community Manager!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/039b1f1b5103c8df9416c04f2effe5ae890a0696.jpg

First and foremost, hello! Hello to faces fresh and familiar, from humble beginnings to pastures new. My name is Aaron Baker and I have recently been granted the unmissable opportunity to work closely with Battalion 1944 and Bulkhead Interactive as their (and more importantly your)  Community Manager.

But what does that mean? 

As the new Community Manager I will have the undeniable pleasure of interacting closely with you, the players, for the foreseeable future of Battalion 1944 and future titles. Whether you’re casual, competitive or constantly on the grind - your opinions, views and general well being fall under my jurisdiction. Your experience within our wonderful and ever expanding game is my experience, and it's my responsibility to help, relay and resolve any issues you may face.

Together we have an exciting opportunity to redefine and reevaluate the scape of team shooters from the ground up. Assess feedback and apply the necessary action so that the team here at Bulkhead can create an environment and community to be proud of.  

Where do we go now?

The future for Battalion is as intriguing as it is exciting. Moving forward, we're looking to keep supporting Battalion with updates, tournaments, special events, and more content. My firm belief is that community and commonwealth hold the key to a solid foundation in which to prosper organically and will make it my utmost responsibility to cater across the board to help you guys do what you do best - play. 

What do those responsibilities entail? 

You lot sure do ask a lot of questions.. But that's the point! Its my main focus to be there at the communities beckon call. Boots on the ground, in the trenches, helping and maintaining all those in need. A humble community medic if you will. The first point of contact for all your Battalion needs. 

This isn’t to say that the developers like Brammer or Howard don’t plan on being on the frontlines, you’ll still see them in-game and being just as attentive as before, but now they’ll be able to focus a little harder on the day to day game work, whilst I relay back all the gripes, bugs, suggestions and ideas from you guys!. 

On top of the general day to day and communicative roles come the tasks of content creation, from simple tutorials for new players all the way up to interesting and exciting events both online and offline for your palpable gaming tastebuds. This could be as mild as helping new tournament organisers find a foothold within the scene or a spicy new event in a number of regions to see the best teams battle it out to reign supreme. 

Regardless of what's in the pipeline you can be sure that Battalion is entering a new era with the approachability to match. At the end of the day, our game, is your game and I’m just excited as you to see what the future holds. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/dc04ed153d3c8c5fd08e38bd43c7137f2e52d903.jpg

How do we contact you?

Contacting me is as easy as can be, through various avenues I’ll be sure to reply on the likes of Twitter and Reddit via @rekabnoraa, though if social media isn’t your thing then feel free to get in touch through the Official Battalion Discord or message me directly - baker#0910.

I look forward to hearing from you all very soon, but first let's kick off this new relationship with something to wet those Wartide whistles. Head over to my twitter, say hello and give my pinned tweet some love. Help me get to know some new faces so I can better help our wonderful community grow. For every 50 retweets I'll even giveaway some of the new Gladiator war chests! 

Thanks everybody
Aaron!

Summer Season Update

ea2619ad97fe8129165e5f213c92a228ffd1.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/03673554b3c64af6e9601fdd95f59693e2982ed9.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/6ef91e1edb04a13a5db6748fb0582345d10efc2f.png

Adding Knives
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/08a6e9f86d3620784863b0d027d718754d9fd1ee.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/f3e8caa45d76b3837e5f6dc82a2532635259f614.png

This update brings our first 'new item' to your inventory and to the marketplace. We wanted to bring more high value items into the fold, enter knives. Whilst this update does not yet contain knife inspects, our Autumn Season Update will give you ample opportunity to show off your new knife collection.

BattleRank Season 5 - Double the Size!
As our seasons now last 2 months, we have doubled the amount of rewards in Season 5 to 21. The rewards are spread across 100 ranks instead of 50. Once you reach level 100, every time you rank up (101, 102 etc) you will receive one of the new Gladiator War Chests!

Take a look at the skins in BattleRank Season 5

b713862daffd922c5a94799ce235d7dbcefe.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/cd0060bb6aaf49bc317fb35686baa7b6bcfc9505.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/76f71a0c0c96b99fd2900f9f31255040412157c7.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/c582b832b8c69f3638b7a7acc80336776b43917f.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/f0ef478703055fb7c39657f2bf0a7c67472e9038.png

Rework of Competitive Maps

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/dd54d83a0f37e96c2f3485bbbdf20d393b85fd7d.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/5ffb67b4e42cc6984a6711b9f2f2b318e87db1a7.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/5f837be6e1fd85561933aabb7c1c029276e10d54.jpg
Map design is a clear area for improvement in Battalion 1944. That's why we'll be pulling Invasion, Docks, and Savoia from the competitive pool for Season 5. We will gradually reintroduce these maps, beginning with Invasion, which is aimed to be tested in our first mid season patch in one months time. We will heavily be involving the community in the map design process. Invasion's rework is being streamed regularly on our lead dev Brammertron's twitch channel.

Patch Notes

Competitive Patch Notes

Tactical Timeout added to Wartide (30 Seconds) (1 per half)
Technical Timeout added to Wartide (60 Seconds) (1 per match)
M1 Carbine firing animation/ironsight lineup fixed
[code]Carbine firing animation now lines up correctly with the actual bullet direction[/code]
Invasion pulled from competitive map rotation for rework
Savoia pulled from competitive map rotation for rework
Docks pulled from competitive map rotation for rework
Wartide Max Tokens changed from 12 > 14 
[code]Players should feel slightly less risk when buying a sniper and full nades now - as well as allowing SMG players to bank more tokens to donate to their scope player.[/code]
Thompson Range Nerf
MP40 Range Nerf
MP28 & Grease Gun Range Nerf
M1 Garand buff & cost in Wartide changed from 3 tokens to 4.
[code]Rate of fire increased by 4%[/code]
BAR cost in Wartide changed from 4 tokens to 3. 



Other Patch Notes

Headquarters mode added as Special Event
Health Feedback Overhauled (Blood Visuals & Sound Queues) 
Health Regen Functionality & Speed Increase
[code]Now, when taking over 70 damage player will enter ‘critical’ status. The critical status is indicated to the player through new audio queues and increased intensity in the blood effects on screen. The player will not regenerate any health for ‘5 seconds’. After the freeze period is over, the player will regenerate to 100% health in ‘1 second’. The player will know when they have fully regenerated by the ‘relaxed breath’ sound queue.[/code]
Skins now save and transfer between rounds
[code]If you pick up a weapon off the ground, the skin will transfer between rounds until you die or pick up a different weapon[/code]
General sound fixes & audio improvements
[code]SVT reskinned to allow bullet movement for the fire anim so bullet gets chambered[/code]
PPS43 fire animation improved
Added inventory item duplicate number
[code]To show how many duplicates of one item you have in your inventory[/code]
Chat overlay background is now always visible
[code]This is to improve chat visibility on brighter maps[/code]
Minimap zoom out amount increased
Improved performance and visuals on water shaders
Knives added to game as item (inspects coming next season)



Bug Fixes


Fixed fog/smoke bug
[code]There was a bug where players who had fog enabled could see the outline of other players in smoke on some maps. This has been fixed for Vanguard, Manorhouse, and Liberation. Please let us know if you have visual evidence of it happening on other maps[/code]
SVT animation fixes
Fixed some Coastal visibility collision issues
Play and Day streaks now showing correct values
Fixed Vanguard see through walls / collision issues
STG shot skipping bug fixed
BAR sprint interpolation animation bug fixed
Kar98 hipfire wrist animation clipping fixed
M1 Carbine left handed arm/clipping issue on animation
Fixed some locations where guns cannot be picked up on Liberation
Improved BAR idle animation and fixed wrist clipping
Fixed BattleRank skins not granting (any issues please use discord)
Fixed blood visual effect not resetting on spawn 
Fixed 'haybale' collision
Various collision fixes
BAR vault animation bug fixed





What's next?

Community Manager Starting Next Week!
Next week our community manager will be joining us and getting into the nitty gritty parts of the community! But don't worry, we want to keep a really strong connection between the devs and the players.

Summer Mid Season Update
The mid season patch gives us an opportunity to change any meta and balancing issues. It also allows us to test out a new map rework. On September 2nd 2019, we will push a game update that amongst other things will contain the ‘new rework’ for Invasion. The map will not be added to the competitive pool straight away but it will enter Unranked 5v5 in the Special Event queue. The idea is that this gives the community a whole month to test out our rework of Invasion and let us know what changes need to be made. Then, when the Autumn Season Update lands at the start of October, we will push the final version live to the game and Invasion will be re-added to the official competitive circuit (FACEIT). We believe this is the best way for us to improve one of our biggest issues, map design. Actively working with the community to solve their issues.

Autumn Season (Season 6)
The Autumn will begin in the first week of October 2019. this does not mean that we won't be updating the game.

One Year Roadmap

https://steamcommunity.com/games/489940/announcements/detail/2709396928711893740

If you're wondering which direction we're looking to take Battalion, look no further. Last week we revealed our one year content plan for Battalion 1944.
You can read that update here.

Thanks,
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Year One FREE Content Roadmap Released!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/50180f261867e0e40b2c157ee582dfc37961a41b.jpg

Hey all,

Today’s community update is about our new free content roadmap for 2019, which you can see above. We have a boatload of community requested features and updates we wish to implement during this first year of post release and beyond - what you’re seeing here is the tip of the iceberg for content this year.

It’s important to note that these are our goals, and regardless of when these things are released we can assure you that all of it is confirmed and in the pipeline of development. Furthermore, all of this post release content will be free to all players. Please bear in mind that this is only our plans for PC content - all these features are currently planned to also arrive within our future console versions of Battalion 1944.

Anyway, enough talking…

Lets finally show you guys the Battalion 1944 roadmap for a full year of post release content supported by Bulkhead Interactive & Square Enix Collective.

The Battalion 1944 Roadmap
The purpose of the following roadmap breakdown is not to announce tiny specific details - instead we’re here with a snapshot overview of what can be expected within this next year of Battalion 1944’s post release development with weekly, monthly and seasonal updates as well as a huge content release at the end of Year 1’s development.

Weekly News Update & Special Event Map Rotation
(Starting with the Summer Seasonal Update, August 1st 2019)

 Different map added to Special Event rotation every week.
 General hotfixes & smaller bug fixes if required weekly.
 Development previews, map playtesting & teasers.


Larger Seasonal Updates (Roughly 8 weeks apart)
Summer Update, Autumn Update, Winter Update, Spring Update

 New arcade & special event game modes.
 New BattleRank season (new & unique skins).
 New FACEIT competitive seasons (with improvements).
 New War Chests (with new items).
 Map reworks released.
 Larger community requested features.
 Larger bug fixes.
 Surprise features & additions.


Mid Season Updates (Roughly 4 Weeks into a season)
Smaller Updates between Seasonal Updates (Roughly 4 weeks apart)

 Weapon balance & meta changes.
 New FACEIT competitive season.
 Weapon and animation/audio overhauls.
 Map rework playtesting.
 Smaller community requested quality of life changes.
 Bug Fixes.


Huge Content Release Early 2020
We can’t wait to start teasing this more… but expect a huge meta shift after this release

 Celebrating one year of Battalion 1944 with a HUGE content release.
 British faction added to competitive reworks of Savoia, Docks & Invasion.
 British weapons added - yeah you heard that right Lee Enfield fans!
 Everything usually included within a seasonal update.
 Additional languages support.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/a8dacc4b5baad3515523706e25008af5b3a0f788.jpg
^Click the above thumbnail for full size preview.

Commitment to Constant Improvement
In case you missed it, our last update detailed our renewed interest in commitment to long term support and growth. This won't happen overnight - however recommitment to the game from ourselves and Square Enix is an exciting prospect for the Battalion 1944 community. If you missed the last update and you’re interested in the position of Bulkhead on Battalion’s future, you can find our last update right here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/489940/announcements/detail/1620650366513201822
This means consistent updates and improvements based on features and quality of life requests you as the Battalion 1944 community have requested!

This commitment begins with August 1st's 'Summer Seasonal Update'.

Announcing $650,000 of Tournament & Competition Support
To support our competitive scene we are also investing further into the community.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/560b22e35ecdc67dd99a65bc0e50f6ea1113656c.png

We recently began the Blitzkrieg Open and Premier Leagues ran by ThePlays, offering $20,000 in prize winnings for the most dedicated Battalion players. This was only the first step in our plan to slowly and steadily grow the competitive scene of Battalion 1944.

You can sign up your team to play right here:
https://theplays.gg/blitzkrieg-summer/ 

What’s next? We’re serious about growing Battalion from it’s grass routes beginnings, as a competitive shooter, over the next year and beyond. We’re happy to announce that we’ll be committing $650,000 towards the growth of multiple Battalion esports events. This doesn’t mean this is the only funding available for the future of Battalion, as things grow we intend to also grow our support of the competitive community.

Where can you as a player get yourself and your team some of that sweet cash as prize money? We’re planning multiple tournaments and events to give all players big reasons to play & improve at the game.


 FACEIT Pro Series - An event geared towards pro level teams.
 Major with Online Qualifiers.
 Championships played in multiple regions.
 Blitzkieg Premier and Open League support.
Online Tournament Support.


There’s going to be a lot of opportunities to compete as we grow as a company and Battalion grows as a franchise. This is just the beginning.

Summer Seasonal Update - Coming August 1st, 2019!

Next week we’ll be dropping the very first seasonal update of many for Year 1. This update is dubbed the ‘Summer Seasonal Update’. Every seasonal update is planned to be bigger & better throughout this year - it’s going to be a wild ride.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/043d44f781e3fde2853bc213acf8272346065cab.jpg

We can’t wait to show you guys next week what’s in store for August 1st and beyond!

Roadmap Release Celebration - Double XP Weekend!

To celebrate the roadmap release and the end of the current BattleRank season we’re going to be running a double XP weekend event to help prepare you for the Summer Seasonal Update.

Double XP weekend will run from Friday 26th 12:00 BST - Monday 29th 12:00 BST.

Have fun with your last chance to earn those sweet BattleRank skins before the season ends!

Earn FREE War Chests - FACEIT Missions This Weekend!

Fire up Battalion this weekend and complete FACEIT competitive missions to win War Chests!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/f12430fff1f9f481f3894349564bd5cccf49cfb0.png


 Play 10 Competitive Games - 5 Red Star Chests
 Win 10 Competitive Games - 1 Heroes Chests
 Win 50 Competitive Games - 3 Heroes Chests


Cheers,
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Official Post Release Roadmap - Coming Soon
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1d6402df67ca8bdd9452bb8fcc7b4102af7239f0.png

Battalion 1944’s launch was a huge success.

Success we knew the game had the potential to have - but couldn’t quite believe ourselves when it started to happen. We have smashed sales expectations, smashed player count expectations (1000 peak was the dream) and recently raised our review score from Mostly Negative to Very Positive. This was done through hard work and absolute support from our community. However - there’s one question that’s on everyone’s lips.

“What’s next?”

We’re doubling down on Battalion 1944. This success has meant ‘post release’ plans have taken a little longer than we would have wanted to spin up, prepare and announce. However, with our belief in this project we’re reinvesting back into Battalion to turn this IP into a long term top tier FPS.

We know Battalion 1944 can be better.
We know the game isn’t perfect.
We echo the same wants & needs as you because we are players too!

We’re a growing independant studio. We have made mistakes, we wear our hearts on our sleeves and we respond as earnestly and honestly as we can about development to our players because this game is something more than just another FPS - Battalion 1944 is the last remaining chance we have as gamers to keep the raw thrill of a skilled and competitive fast paced FPS relevant within this rapidly changing landscape. 

Our publishing friends at Square Enix Collective understands that significance and will be helping us support this community every step of the way. Battalion 1944’s success has sent a message that this style of FPS is something that can thrive within the modern era - and with love, polish, time & your continued support over the next few years - we can take Battalion to where we aim it to be in the long term.

In the short term however - some players want more content, some players want map redesigns, some players want overall polish and stability, some players want the competitive scene to grow with leagues and tournaments to play for...

We have a plan to deliver on ALL of those wishes. 

We’ve been reading every single piece of feedback since launch and have worked to create a roadmap with a bunch of new content, gamemodes, polish and fixes that address all of these concerns.

This is why we’ll be releasing a development roadmap very soon - prior to the launch of BattleRank Season 5!

We’ve doubled down our investment into Battalion 1944 by expanding our development team significantly purely for this post release content and we can’t wait to share our plans with you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/15885898babb566c35834f1cbc286b0049f98564.png

Focusing on the Big Picture - New & Casual Player Experience
The goal with the upcoming roadmap is not to be worrying about, or trying to force, the player base to grow too early - it's about making Battalion 1944 a better game throughout the next year, so that when we do free weekends and sales and new players flood back into the game at key points - they get an even better experience than the update before.

Every single update we’re going to be focusing on improving that new player & casual player experience, which coincidently will mean huge quality of life improvements for existing hardcore players. This will mean more content, more players and more polish based on your feedback. Making sure players feel like they can transition from new players, to casual players, to competitive players and eventually beginning their path to pro is very important to us. This means helping new players get to grips with the game is our number one priority and focus with new features and development.

It will take time to shape Battalion 1944 into this ideal package, meaning we need our existing playerbase to have faith and commit to playing through the lulls to keep Battalion 1944 healthy and strong. That way, when we arrive at those key dates and we market & push the game infront of new players, they want to stick around and continue to help grow Battalion 1944.

Competitive Roadmap Begins
Battalion 1944 managed to capture the hopes and dreams of young and veteran FPS lovers worldwide. We will be growing the competitive side of the game at the same rate as Battalion’s potential, which will grow ever bigger as development & support continues for years to come.
We’re currently in the process of organising Battalion’s competitive future. But it’s important that our players know that we aren’t just blindly throwing six figure prize pools at tournaments in the next two months when the game isn’t ready.

We’re under no illusions that Battalion as a brand has a way to go before it can enter the top tier of FPS titles that we intend it to eventually become. This doesn’t mean that we aren’t intending to support our competitive player base until those days inevitably arrive in 5/10 years time. In the meantime - we want Battalion 1944 to provide that dream for our new & dedicated players - the path for anyone to become a professional gamer.

This is why we’re happy to announce today the first step in our three tiered plan for competitive play...

Announcing The Blitzkrieg League


The first phase of our Tournament Roadmap begins with the Summer Season Update...
Ran and organised by our friends over at The Plays, we want to introduce players to our competitive league format with some nice prize pool bonuses for playing.

Official Website of Blitzkrieg Summer:
https://theplays.gg/blitzkrieg-summer/

The first step towards your path to pro begins in the Blitzkrieg Open League.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/560b22e35ecdc67dd99a65bc0e50f6ea1113656c.png

Open League - Open to everyone. At the end of the season the four best teams will progress into the playoffs with   their share of prize pool and a chance to qualify for the premier division. The “Relegation” cup at the end of the season will be the one and only way to qualify for the premier division.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1d6402df67ca8bdd9452bb8fcc7b4102af7239f0.png

Everyone has the opportunity to graduate from the Open Division into the premier division.

Premier League - 2 groups, each group has 6 teams. Top 4 teams will be going into playoffs. The top 6 teams will get their share of the prize pool depending on their placement in playoffs. The last team of each group will go into the “relegation cup” against the top 4 teams of Open League and they will fight for their spot in the premier division.

The qualification method for the Season 1 of the Premier Division positions are still being decided. Follow @ThePlaysGG on twitter for up to date information.

Summer 2019 Season Prizing

Open
Start: August 1st 2019
End: October 6th 2019
Total Prizing: $3,000
1st Place: $1,500
2nd Place: $750
3rd Place: $500
4th Place: $250

Premier						
Start: August 1st 2019
End: October 6th 2019
Total Prizing: $7,000
1st Place: $3,500
2nd Place: $1,750
3rd Place: $750
4th Place: $500
5th Place: $250
6th Place: $250

With this commitment to growth from us at Bulkhead with the backing of Square Enix its a no brainer for anyone wanting to follow the dream and invest your time for the long term. As you’re reading this the competition is already starting to practice - what are you waiting for?

Grab your mates & sign up to the Open League next week right here: https://theplays.gg/blitzkrieg-summer/ 


Hiring Full Time Community Manager
We’ve been working insanely hard on plans and development, meaning we’ve almost been too busy to communicate directly with our players as much as we would like. We’re happy to announce we have hired a community manager to help connect our playerbase to us as developers with the regular communication you deserve across Steam, Discord and Reddit. 

The person we’ve hired is a well known figure within our own community who will help us structure and grow our game based on your feedback and concerns.

Our Community Manager starts bright and early on the 5th August 2019 - and we can’t wait to introduce you to them!


Closing Comments
We’re on this journey with you as players like no other studio before us. We’ve shown time and time again that we eventually  deliver on what the community wants from us when given the time & patience that’s needed with a smaller game development studio. We’re asking you to believe in us once again and to keep playing the game as we lead up to previewing our content plans every month.

The first seasonal update - The Summer Update drops August 1st.

Excited? We’ll be previewing the content in this update later this month… stay tuned to our Official Twitter, Discord and Steam news to stay in the loop with everything you need to know.

For now - We’ll be on the servers this weekend playing with you guys.

Play Battalion 1944 Competitive this weekend and receive a FREE War Chest!
