notes.title: Patch 23011 - BattleRank Season 4, Unranked Wartide & Shotgun Nerf LIVE!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/2392583092aec929177a9986b9d4a61f323d6eda.jpg

Hey all! 

Patch 23011 is now LIVE!
The entire server update process could take up to 2 hours of downtime.
See you on the other side!

Here's what is in this season's update:

Special Event - Unranked Wartide Trial

We’ve heard your requests for a casual Wartide queue. To replace the shotgun sendoff special event, we’re trialing an unranked version of Wartide in its place. It's important for players to understand that we need to be careful when implementing new playlists, as it further splits the playerbase between matchmaking queues - which could end up detrimental to the Battalion 1944 experience long term. We’ll be watching player distribution carefully to make a clear & informed decision on the queues permanence at a later date.

Another reason for this trial is to test for issues and bugs related to bots within Wartide. We would like to introduce bots to Faceit competitive play to alleviate the impact of leavers (allowing you to take control of a bot after you die if a teammate has left). However we want to use this trial to identify bugs and issues that can be fixed using the casual unranked setting before rolling out this change to competitive play.

However, we fully understand the desire for a fun & relaxed version of the gamemode that’s casual enough to enjoy without the pressures of ranked play. 

We were concerned with 5v5 being too intense for new players. Hopefully with this playlist and its increased 10v10 player count, we can encourage new players to transition from arcade and learn the basic rules of Wartide, including map layouts and mechanics before queueing into competitive play. 10v10 will alleviate the pressure for inexperienced players with more players to kill and less focus on their individual play. Experienced players on the other hand will be able to take a break from competitive, frag out like it's arcade and indirectly show new players who are spectating tips, tricks and how to play in clutch situations.

Unranked Wartide Rules

10v10.
MR6.
Knife Round Enabled.
Overtime Enabled (MR3)
Bots Enabled (Testing)
Lower match completion bonus than competitive play.


We’ll be watching how this plays out and looking in #bug_reports on the official Discord to see what issues arise!

Wartide XP Bonus

To balance out the XP gain between Wartide & Arcade playlists - we’re raising the match bonus reward for completing a match of Wartide to make sure your time is rewarded correctly!

BattleRank Season 4

With the end of a season comes a new one!
Exactly like last season - reach level 50 and you get the animated skin!

BattleRank Season 4 is now LIVE!


Bronze Level 1 	|	MP28 - Green Camo
Bronze Level 5 	|	Grease Gun - Ivory Three
Silver Level 10	|	STG44 - Friend of Jack
Silver Level 15  	|	Kar98k - Grizzly Hunter
Gold Level 20 	|	M1 Garand - Deathbringer
Gold Level 25 	| 	M1 Garand - Ivory Seven
Platinum Level 30 	|	MP40 - Wings	
Platinum Level 35 	| 	M1 Carbine - Ivory Six
Emerald Level 40 	| 	STG44 - Ivory Eight
Emerald Level 45 	| 	Thompson | Stealth Flawless	
Diamond Level 50+ | 	Shotgun - Lionheart (ANIMATED)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/e868b544002439e84c03a2cf6b70fc346180d8a7.png

Season 4 and its rewards were planned in advance and will function the same as the Season 3 - however next season we’ve got some new updates coming to the BattleRank implementation for more rewards simply for playing!

Shotgun Balance Changes

BattleRank Season 3’s most effective weapon has been brought back to earth for Season 4.
 A combination of changes have made the weapon effective at close ranges only - making the weapon much less of a threat overall.

Due to community feedback and the obvious power of the shotguns they have been altered to become situational weapons that are intended to be played in close quarters ranges and off angles rather than an ‘all round’ weapon choice. This means there will be positions where the cheap 2 coin shotgun will have its place to allow you to surprise and pick off unprepared players and take their weapon as your own.

Shotgun Maximum Range Heavily Reduced
The longest possible range of the shotgun has been heavily reduced from 4096 units to 1536 units - meaning all shotgun pellets now become entirely ineffective after the 1536 unit range. This will stop players being able to finish off low health players with the shotgun at long range. Players will need to learn this new effective distance before taking shots that previously would have connected.

Damage has been slightly increased at very close range (within 512 units) - meaning only 3/8 pellets must hit the enemy to get a one shot kill.

At its new longest possible range (1536 units) - all pellets need to hit a target to get a 1 shot kill. In the majority of cases you’ll need to fire 2-3 pumps at this distance to hit enough pellets for a kill.

Between these new minimum and maximum ranges of 512 & 1536 units, damage will fall off the further away you are from the target.

Shotgun Crosshair & Spread Accurately Represented

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/1f52d0e502bab970a8019488c8ec98af02065f5c.jpg

Its very important to remember that shotgun damage is based on how many pellets connect with the target. The closer you are the tighter the spread! There is no RNG on where the pellets will land - it’s purely based on centering your aim over the player & making sure the pellets connect.

However - to help with communication we’ve decided to bring in the spread of the crosshair to more accurately portray where pellets will land - this will hopefully reduce the frustrating moments where a player at close range who has only part of their crosshair over the enemy misses due to none of the pellets connecting.

BAR Balance Changes

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/61bb029ffc8386dfd08194bce25885bbda6c60ad.jpg
New BAR Ironsight to match the STG44


BAR now has 30 rounds instead of 20
BAR weapon reload sway reduced by 60%
New audio for firing
Cost increased from 3 > 4 Tokens


M1 Garand Changes

Cost Reduced from 4 > 3 Tokens


Knife Changes

To reduce the viability of ‘prone knifing’ we have reduced the reach of the knife when in any stance that isn’t standing, meaning you’ll have to be closer to the enemy to get a kill when in crouch or prone stance.


Standing has the furthest reach.
Crouching knifing has slightly less reach than standing
Prone knifing has significantly less reach than crouching


Map Changes
- Docks now has a wall to prevent allies sniping directly into the Axis spawn church

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/4472a2c94cb6607ac5bd832b4e8d6400a14e3f03.jpg

Bug Fixes & Misc

 Potential fix for the ‘infinite reload’ bug (special thanks to supreme, bAAz and Tobin)
 Potential fix for disappearing arms when using left handed viewmodel
 Disabled all voting in FFA game modes to reduce abuse of the kick function.
 Added profanity filter to ingame chat to help reduce abusive language
 Fixed collision issues on multiple maps

notes.title: Pre-Season 4 Update - Shotgun Nerf Incoming, BattleRank Season 3 ends 1st July 2019
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/465b99a65e5e9efee3dfa0cf173dea73f02758e1.jpg

What a month it has been for Battalion 1944, coming back from the jaws of Early Access and being propelled back into the FPS spotlight. It was great to celebrate the successful release with the rivals event hosted and directed by Twitch themselves - and shows more than our own community that the potential for competitive viewership is there.

Looking forward to the end of this month, comes the end of BattleRank Season 3.

BattleRank Season 3 Officially Ends 1st July 2019
The next few days will be your last chance to reach BattleRank Level 50+ to receive your very own animated STG44 | Glow which reacts to your gameplay!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/571631020f3486536d42fc090e041a3e05481e3e.png

https://youtu.be/1CiBsm7EZjc

As many people have pointed out, the current market value of the STG44 | Glow is higher than the cost of the game. We would say that’s pretty good value for your money & time!

https://steamcommunity.com/market/listings/489940/STG44%20%7C%20Glow

Double XP Weekend!

To increase your chances of reaching level 50 before the weekend is over, we’re introducing double XP - which will run for this weekend only until the launch of BattleRank Season 4!

Weekend Special Event - Shotgun Sendoff

If there’s anything Battlerank Season 3 (Faceit Season 2) will be remembered for - it’ll be the Trenchgun meta. This weekend will be your last chance to decimate with the shotgun in its current state before they become a blast from the past… and to celebrate that we’re running a weekend only event in our limited time only queue called ‘Shotgun Sendoff’

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/167c42b713b7f75dd102e5eec2f921a3217ca227.png

This is purely a fun event for the last few days of Season 3 and will help you get those sweet experience points to level your BattleRank before Season 4 begins.

Balance Changes Coming With BattleRank Season 4

With every season we will re-evaluate the Battalion 1944 metagame if needs be. Letting the season play out has ensured that we see which weapons have the largest issues that need addressing for the following season, whilst keeping gameplay consistent for competitive & tournament play within the current season. Disruption through hotfixes should only be reserved for fixing game breaking issues & crashes (for example the endless CTF bug). 

Having more time also enables us to address the issues in a clearer way by gathering all of the feedback and addressing the correct issues rather than knee jerk responses based on individual clips. Balance will always be an ongoing process - but with Monday’s patch will come a new meta that will evolve throughout that season. We’re looking forward to seeing what strategies prevail as players become accustomed to the changes! 

July 1st’s balance changes will be detailed in Monday’s patch notes along with the client update.
But yes… the shotgun has been reworked!

Faceit - INSIGHT INTO MATCHMAKING 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/e026b6627dd36226b72f3a7914aa48cfd22a85f4.png

Talking about Wartide - The team at Faceit have put together an amazing article on how Matchmaking in Battalion 1944 works and how it could be improved over time. For anyone who’s wondering about why and how certain matchups happen - take a read over on their official site here: 

https://blog.faceit.com/insight-into-matchmaking-in-battalion-1944-f34481db45ca


Client Update & BattleRank Season 4 - Releases 1st July 2019

BattleRank Season 4 will bring a new set of skins for you to play for aswell as a client update with new content and bug fixes. We'll be sharing more details along with the release patch notes on July 1st!

Hope to see you all grinding on the servers this weekend!
- Bulkhead Interactive

Hey all!

Another amazing day for Battalion 1944 yesterday, obliterating our expectations and setting our record number of concurrent players and most copies sold since full release! We’re thrilled with the support we’re receiving to bring back old school shooters - with players and streamers flocking to get their dose of the Battalion 1944 hype through word of mouth.

Free For All - Rifles Only playlist lands on Invasion
Our event playlist fittingly lands on the beaches of Normandy with Invasion being this week’s map in the playlist rotation.

Faceit Improve Party Management &  Quality of Life Features!

 SEA Servers - Coming Soon!

 Muzzle Flash - Weapon Feedback Polish 
The ordering of actions when firing a weapon has been adjusted so that the muzzle flash appears the exact frame the mouse button is pressed rather than a few frames after to help communicate to players when the bullet leaves the weapon. (Thanks u/int64shrandy)

 Party management can now be handled within the competitive screen instead of overlay.

A Bright Future for Battalion 1944

As Battalion 1944 goes from strength to strength - we’re already working on long term plans with our publisher Square Enix & our amazing partners at Faceit for sustainability both for the competitive scene and juicy arcade content. We’re full steam ahead on post release development and we can’t wait to share all the juicy news with you guys!

Here’s to a bright future for our growing Battalion 1944 community.

Thanks,
Bulkhead Interactive

Challenges return, pre season weapon tuning, important bug fixes and...
'Free For All - Rifles Only' playlist heads to Savoia!

Hey all!

We’re amazed! We couldn’t be more grateful to our community for helping us get Battalion 1944 to this point. To see social media flooding with comments on how Battalion 1944 has taken people back to their ‘glory days’ of gaming has been overwhelming. We simply can’t respond to all of you, but thank you for letting us know how you feel about Battalion. 

Trust us, after 3 years of hard work and highs and lows, we could not be happier with this response to the full release!

The Stats: Player Numbers & Game Growth

For the first 6 days of launch Battalion’s player count grew and grew every single day, all the way into the mid week! This exceeded everyone’s expectations. It’s pretty rare in the games industry to achieve this kind of growth after an early access launch (especially after one like ours!) so we’re confident that we’re doing the right thing and that we just need to keep going and supporting the game with updates. The most interesting stat to us, is that on the day where the player numbers growth slowed, we also sold more copies of Battalion than any other day, as well as receiving solid sustained player numbers in NA. We can only assume that the game will keep growing from here as we continue to support the game.

So... onto the news!

Fixes for Menu Stuttering & Faceit Stuttering
Some users were experiencing issues with the main menu stuttering - especially new users who had not played Battalion 1944 before or in a very long time. This is a very multifaceted bug, meaning previous fixes we’ve deployed would work for certain users but not others!

However, thanks to your reports we’ve nailed the main reasons this would occur & have deployed fixes. We’re confident in saying 99% of the main menu stuttering issues should be fixed within this update. If anyone experiences more stutters of a similar nature (game related not server) - then please post in our bug report section on the Steam discussions!

 Significantly reduced CPU usage on main menu video 

We have also reduced CPU usage in the main menus by reducing the size and impact of the main menu background video! Enjoy a much smoother experience from today!

Further Load Time Improvements
Whilst we still recommend using an SSD over outdated HDDs for players loading into maps - we have made improvements to load times on initial boot as well as small gains when loading into maps (especially the new maps Vanguard, Docks and Goldrush!) This should help players failing to connecting to a match in time before the match is automatically cancelled.

Challenges Are Back!
We did have some hiccups at launch, it’s true. But as we finish up our first week as a released game we have crushed most of the core bugs. Challenges are now once again visible to players on the Battlerank screen. You have been completing challenges the whole time you’ve been playing and receiving chests for them, this fix just allows you to see what you’ve been doing! 

Ladder Climbing Improvements
Ladders were sometimes a bit difficult to ‘climb off’ of once you reached the top. We have lowered the ‘top point’ of most of the ladders in the game in all maps.

Rebalanced XP on Medals
Some of the medals were extremely generous with XP - making it more beneficial to play Arcade over Wartide. This has been refined for a more balanced experience!

Weapon Changes & Balancing Improvements
M1 Garand
Reload time buffed from 1.8 seconds to 1.25 seconds
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fDwAs5moU_4&feature=youtu.be
MP40
Reduced headshot damage at long range
Thompson
Reduced headshot damage at long range
PPSh-41
Reduced headshot damage at long range
Damage falloff begins at a closer range than other SMGs
M1 Carbine
Extra ammo buffed from 30 > 45 (Total 60 Bullets)
Gewehr 43
Extra ammo buffed from 30 > 45 (Total 60 Bullets)
SVT-40
Extra ammo buffed from 30 > 40 (Total 50 Bullets)

TL;DR
- Chunking maps to improve initial boot load time, as well as load time into newer maps
- Changes to M1 Garand reload speed.
- Changes to SMG’s long range capabilities.
- Changes to Carbines to have more reserve ammo.
- Fixed collision issues on Liberation.
- Fixed collision issues on Coastal.
- Fixed collision issues on Vanguard.
- Updated Savoia minimap.
- Added bot points of interest (POI) on Battery, Vanguard, Docks and AimKosak.
- Re-enabled challenges.
- Fix for an exploit where if you leaned and then vaulted, your third person would no longer lean in third person but it would in first person.
- Reduced XP rewards for some arcade only medals.
- Replaced the main menu video with a lower quality version, should improve main menu performance and initial boot load time.
- Removed the ability to turn off post round audio notifications. Instead they can only be turned to a low volume level to help players know when a round has ended.
- Added a potential fix for the menu stutter seen by some players. This may also fix the looping login on the faceit competitive screen.
- Improvements to ladders on all maps.


See you in the servers!
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Patch 22602 Notes, Load Times, Arcade & Rifles Only!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/e5adfb36ed070c59d3cd2b313e3d4a874c608b05.jpg
After a successful weekend, patch 22602 improves load times and brings back the Arcade & Rifles Only playlists!

Hey all!

Launch weekend has been amazing - we’ve seen a massive resurgence of interest in Battalion 1944, with players and streamers worldwide picking up the game and getting stuck in. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=urmR5sQccGI&feature=youtu.be

After a great first weekend, we saw the player numbers grow every day from release, this is a great sign for the longevity of the game! Whilst we completely anticipate the numbers to dip slightly or flatten out due to it now being weekdays rather than the weekend, we are thrilled that we were able to continue to grow our player base daily over this past weekend giving us the confidence we need to continue working on and improving Battalion 1944. 


A consistent daily playerbase is more important than a large influx of players who drop off - and our curve is indicating just that, as nice stable playerbase... and we haven't even done a free weekend yet! If you guys keep playing and supporting Battalion 1944 - we’ll continue to support the games growth with new content, updates and fixes.

So - onto the news!

Arcade & Special Events Queue
After the game went live on Thursday and our game was exposed to thousands we saw issues with players not being put on the same team correctly and having issues searching. Whilst the searching issues were fixed that night, the auto balance issue was still outstanding. We decided to temporarily remove Arcade and Rifles Only as queues from the game and instead directed players towards the server browser as a temporary measure to ensure players could find matches.

However, today we have officially reopened the Arcade and Special Event queue. We will run this event until Friday! When we’ll be running a different special event for the weekend, watch out this week for that announcement.

Load Time Improvements
We are aware there are issues relating to load times, particularly for players on hard drives instead of an SSD. In this patch we have made some nice improvements to the load times so you can get into games faster - however we still recommend installing the game on an SSD for now. We plan to make more load time improvements, specifically for the new maps, later in the week when we can safely test some new improvements.


Economy Sniper & Rifle Changes Wartide
As we are still in pre-season (Until May 31st) we were comfortable with making some final tweaks to this seasons economy. Although we are aware that some people believe certain weapons are overpowered, we’d like to allow a meta to properly develop in a tournament setting before we make reactive changes to the game. However, the following changes are designed to make the game more strategic for high level players whilst at the same time not punishing new players. We will be making the following changes.


Kar98k 5 Tokens > 6 Tokens
Kar98k Scoped 5 Tokens > 7 Tokens
Mosin Nagant 5 Tokens > 6 Tokens
Mosin Nagant Scoped 5 Tokens > 7 Tokens
Springfield 5 Tokens > 6 Tokens

General Faceit Improvements
Obviously, this is the first time anyone has attempted to embed Faceit’s competitive tools this deep into a game, so it’ll have some issues. However, the Faceit team and Bulkhead have been actively working on fixes and improvements through this weekend. We would like to also point out that many of you have asked ‘why am I getting matchmade with incredible players’. This is because we currently are gathering the data needed to determine who is good and who is… not so good! During this pre-season we’ll be tweaking the elo system and trying to find a great balance for Faceit Season 1.

The economy updates and Faceit improvements will be going live at approximately 17:00 BST, your Faceit server will not restart or close the servers will simply change over when the update goes live, you don’t need to lift a finger! However, a new client update is available to download now. Head over to Steam to get the new patch.

Blitzkrieg Battles Returns, Win $500!
The Plays have returned with Blitzkrieg Battles in the EU and NA. This week we see the first EU teams face off for first prize! Registration is now open, visit The Plays for more info!


See you in the servers!
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: Announcing Rifles Only Special Event and Team Ladders!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/2dffe9803f8abe70cb1d92859a34365a1ab0fa4a.jpg
Coming to Battalion this weekend is a special Rifles Only event and Heroes Team Ladders!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xnczRauTudc&feature=youtu.be
We are hurtling towards from full release later today, it’s time for us to announce a little extra feature we’ve been working on that classic FPS fans will love! After spending hours and hours on official 24/7 rifles only servers - we’ve decided to open a new limited time event queue that will let players do exactly that.

The first ever Battalion 1944 limited time event:
Free for All 24/7 Rifles Only - on the new russian map, Vanguard
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/46da03263198c997710fa61b6874a88deda97017.jpg
Even better news is that - on official event servers - you still gain XP, medals and rewards for your gameplay! Meaning you’ll be able to jumpstart your BattleRank Season 3 progress with a blast on the new Vanguard map with bolt action rifles.

This only the first limited time event that we’ll be running… did someone say  baikals only?

Battalion 1944 is now finally feeling like a polished game with it’s own identity and feel. It’s roots are deep and strong, grounded in classic shooters such as COD2, COD4 and Enemy Territory. You can feel the inspiration bleeding through into Battalion’s movement and gunplay… just updated with the challenges, progression and competitive faceit integration that FPS games like this need in the modern gaming landscape.

THE HEROES LADDER
We’re excited to announce another unique competitive feature coming to Battalion! Courtesy of The Plays, we will be running monthly ladders for teams to compete in with prizes and fierce competition in every region we support!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/039e82e2a6fdf543bf514149266b1cddc7fc7c8f.jpg

What is The Heroes Ladder?
The Heroes Ladder is a monthly competition for teams. Teams compete whenever they like at any time of the day against other teams in the ladder. Points are given for wins and taken away for losses. The regular seasons of The HL will contribute towards your Faceit elo. 
How do I join The Heroes Ladder?
To join the ladder, you’ll need to create a team on Faceit first, on the left hand side there is a button where you can click on “teams” in the faceit web browser, client, or in-game overlay. 
If you're ready to join the Heroes Ladder, you can join here: www.theplays.gg/faceit
Where do I find the ladder in game once I have joined?
You can use the ladder in game or using faceit outside of the game via web or client. When in game, enter the competitive screen and click ‘tournaments’ in the top right. The Faceit overlay will appear. On the right side of the overlay click on the ‘Hubs’ drop down. 
How do I join a match?
Your captain will need to click on the ‘play’ button on the Ladder/Hub specifically in the in-game overlay, client, or website. You should make sure you are in-game sitting on the competitive menu, the game will automatically place you in the match and will take you to the map vote screen!

We can’t wait to see you guys on the servers tonight!

Battalion 1944 Full Release will go live today!

17:00 (BST)
09:00 (PST)
18:00 (CEST)
13:00 (BRT)
02:00 (AEST)

The update size is 7.8GB (If you have the old version installed).
Please be aware Valve is incharge of setting the game live 'around' these times.


See you in the servers!
Bulkhead Interactive

notes.title: New Weapons: Russian Automatic Weapons
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/41ed5517fef606139631aed2303f1b98dc4df9b3.jpg
The Russian automatic weapons are challenging, exciting, rewarding, and lethal!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0YgZeeyqpzg&feature=youtu.be
We're super pumped to be able to finally start revealing some of the Russian weapons coming to Battalion 1944 on May 23rd 2019!

The Russian weapons carry similar traits to the American and German weapons, but always with a slight twist and a dash of rugged Russian personality.

PPS-43
The PPS-43 is the Russian default weapon that all players initially spawn with. Despite having the same stats as the Grease Gun and the MP28, the PPS-43 is a favourite of some of the devs. It's familiar recoil pattern and powerful sound effect make it feel epic to fire into your opponents. Whilst it's far from the most powerful weapon in the game, it's an intense weapon to play with and it feels great to rattle off shots.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/de829b9763583997ddcb577574a7a323ffa597ec.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/dc3022ebf47cc6204bf6706e9bfb2b0a1f44d53a.jpg

Fedorov Avtomat
The Fedorov Avtomat takes centre stage as the Russian equivalent of the STG-44 or the BAR. It's sluggish rate of fire is made up for by its power and ability to kill with just one shot to the head. Don't be under any illusions, this is a tough weapon to handle. But if you can wrangle it, your opponents are in for one hell of a ride. If you're skilled at controlling recoil, this is the gun for you. If you can tame it you'll lay waste to anyone who dares cross an open street. The Federov is a jack of all trades with a great sound.. 'Dush Dush Dush Dush'
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/f203ae5f1f14f75f300db1b155afc4e70a20ea94.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/ef2b8ccba87ed2597606ae8c1dddaaacdc2c9ef5.jpg

PPSh-41
The PPSh is a fan favourite amongst history buffs, competitive gamers, and old school shooter fans alike. In the current generation it is regularly reduced to a weak and pithy rapid 'pea shooter'. Not in Battalion, we have restored the PPSh to its rightful place as king of the sub machine guns. Tearing through enemies who enter its peak range. With 35 bullets spraying out of its drum in just a few seconds, it's a weapon anyone can pick up, but only few can master. When we began designing the PPSh in Battalion we had one goal in mind.. Make The PPSh Great Again! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/9be34f5e337b8c4d5bebc3332589fd5b2ed58734.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/a9912a10f6a8e4cb809a711e7eb086c14bc1de03.jpg

Skins
Russia's mystique and rich history has given our artists a great starting point for some truly special skins. Wanting to give a nod to some of the wild beasts of Russia sharing metaphorical similarities with our take on these iconic weapons. Here are just 3 of the many skins you'll be able to equip when playing as the Russians on May 23rd.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/79dac11e027e900f10da426c73828083d5494ac4.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/50e13faec5a91aebddc27ebad74112dca4a3a56c.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26062409/fb950c515e26cbafca24f8b9b710fe861ad98838.png

Do you have any ideas for naming these skins? Let us know in the comments or on twitter.. Tweet us @Battalion1944, if we use your name we may just send you the skin!

Thanks everyone, still even more content and announcements to come!
Bulkhead
